items.name: Treasure Hunters mini-season
items.notes: Ends Chapter 7 Season 4 "Override" and starts a new Ranked season. Epic's status window runs 07:00–10:00 SAST with no promised return time — season launches often take 4–7 hours, so it may run longer.
